mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, statistics_id, basic_class, classify_id, classify_name, specification, material_is_whole, warehouse_type, type, project_id, quantity, length, width, thickness, theory_thickness, brand, heat_no_and_batch_no, color, mete, unit_net, warehouse_id, workshop_id, weight_measurement_mode, invoice_type, tax_rate, standard_id, standard_name, weighted_average_price_id, unit_price, unit_price_excluding_vat, amount, amount_excluding_vat, input_vat
mapper.select: select * from wms_statistics_begin_period where date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{createTime}, '%Y-%m')

select statistics_id id, sum(mete) mete,
unit_price_excluding_vat unitPriceExcludingVAT, sum(input_VAT) inputVAT, sum(amount) amount, sum(amount_excluding_VAT) amountExcludingVAT,
sum(quantity) quantity from wms_statistics_begin_period where bool_delete_enum = 0 and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{createTime}, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY statistics_id,unit_price_excluding_vat

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m' ) date, ifnull(sum(mete),0) mete, CASE WHEN #{type} = 1 THEN sum(ifnull(amount, 0)) WHEN #{type} = 2 THEN sum(ifnull(amount_excluding_vat, 0)) END amount FROM wms_statistics_begin_period WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 AND date_format( create_time, '%Y' ) = date_format( #{year}, '%Y' ) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m' )
